title: The XOR bouncers: the right-end layer decoded, one model for six machines
text: For the six machines of the two XOR tables (1RB1LE_0LC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE1RD_1RA0RC_1LB---, 1RB---_0RC0LA_1LD0RB_1LE0LB_1LF0LC_1LB1RE and their siblings), the thin layer at the right end of the tape runs as its own small machine that learns one bit from the XOR bulk per round trip. The model predicts every round trip of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps of all six, and the two tables differ on a single tail. Its sweep rules and its only halting pattern (an even group followed by a touching 1) are proved in Lean; 100,000 tails reached under every input bit contain no halt.
